key_catalyst: IBM's AI-spending warning triggering a historic ~25% single-day selloff
reasoning: The session's dominant shock — IBM's ~25% plunge on an AI-spending warning — was a largely idiosyncratic single-name blow-up that QQQ absorbed with only a -0.84% drift, not a broad AI-trade breakdown. Critically, the live chip/AI complex got POSITIVE intraday fuel (ASML lifting its 2026 outlook as Intel deploys High NA EUV) plus a softer-than-expected inflation print, both of which directly counter the morning's SECTOR_ROTATION SELL thesis. What remains unresolved is whether IBM's warning reignites AI-valuation angst overnight and the latent margin-debt/Hormuz tails, but neither escalated into the close.
